summary: Full-stack test of Kivo (multi-game mod hosting). Created a pytest regression suite (69 tests, 5 files) covering public discovery/download, auth+RBAC, creator tools, admin/staff panel and engagement: 63 passed / 6 failed (91.3%). Playwright covered public home/browse/mod-detail/download, register+login (admin, creator, new user), creator dashboard + 4-step wizard + multipart version upload, and the whole admin panel (overview, review queue w/ approve+reason modal+version diff, reports SLA resolve/dismiss/filters, users & trust incl. trust tier/role/verify/shadow/ban/revoke, audit log, anomalies), plus review/comment submission and role scoping. Found and FIXED one page-breaking React crash on /admin/queue and /admin/reports. All 6 backend failures are genuine product gaps (no brute-force lockout, revoke-sessions is a no-op, no httpOnly cookie, unapproved mods publicly readable, age_confirm not enforced, blank comments accepted). All QA-created data was removed and the seeded state (9 mods, 6 users, quantum-tools-beta in_review, 2 open reports) was restored.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout/rate limiting. 6+ consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no throttle (playbook requires lockout after 5 fails). Credential stuffing is unmitigated.

Only writes session_revoked_at; get_current_user never checks it, so previously issued JWTs remain valid for their full 7 days. The UI toast claims 'user force-logged-out' - a false security guarantee. Verified: /api/auth/me still returns 200 after revoke.

Returns mods of ANY status, so in_review / rejected / quarantined mods are publicly readable by slug (verified 200 on quantum-tools-beta). Should 404 unless status==approved or requester is owner/staff.

Approving a version unconditionally sets the parent mod status to 'approved' (server.py:607-608), so approving one version silently un-quarantines / un-rejects a mod that staff previously quarantined.

minor.issue: Never sets the httpOnly access_token cookie even though get_current_user reads request.cookies.get('access_token') (server.py:85) - dead code path; token lives only in localStorage (XSS-readable).
age_confirm is declared on RegisterInput but never validated; registration with age_confirm=false succeeds with 200 (UI enforces it, API does not).
Accepts blank/whitespace-only body (CommentInput.body has no min_length) - empty comments are persisted and rendered.
Recomputes rating_count from stored reviews only, destroying seeded social proof: Arcane Ascension went 4.6 (2100 ratings) -> 4.0 (1) after one real review.

No file size cap (unbounded `await file.read()` into memory) and detected_type is only mimetypes.guess_type(filename) i.e. extension-based, while the UI claims 'Server-side type verification runs on upload'.
allow_credentials=True combined with CORS_ORIGINS='*' is invalid per the CORS spec; browsers reject credentialed wildcard responses. Use explicit origins.
Seeded pending version for quantum-tools-beta has file_path='' - if a moderator approves it via the queue, /api/download/{id} returns 404 'File missing'.
Settable via /api/admin/users/{id}/trust but never enforced anywhere - shadow-banned users' comments/reviews stay fully visible.
No pagination; hard-coded to_list(50/300/500) caps will silently truncate at scale.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: `useEffect(load, [])` passed an async fn returning a Promise, so React called the Promise as the cleanup fn -> uncaught 'TypeError: destroy is not a function'. The CRA error overlay covered the entire /admin/queue and /admin/reports pages, making the review queue and reports queue unusable. Changed to useEffect(() => { load(); }, [...]).

All 6 sidebar items are shown to every staff role. As content_reviewer, clicking 'Users & Trust' loads a permanently blank page with only an 'Insufficient role' toast. Hide/disable non-permitted nav items and render an inline permission-denied state.

Search only fires on Enter (form submit). There is no visible submit button and no debounced live filtering, so typing appears to do nothing (verified: 3s after typing 'shader' all 12 cards remained; pressing Enter correctly narrowed to 1).
No hamburger menu; Browse / Minecraft links are hidden on mobile, leaving only a search icon, avatar and logout. Primary navigation is unreachable on phones.
approve / request-changes / reject / quarantine are icon-only with no labels or tooltips - destructive vs non-destructive actions are indistinguishable.
'AVG RATING' averages rating_avg across ALL mods including brand-new 0-rated ones, showing a misleadingly low 3.04 for a creator whose live mods are all 4.4-4.9. Average only rated mods.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows success toast '[SESSIONS] Revoked - user force-logged-out' but the backend does not invalidate the token, so the target user stays logged in. Misleading confirmation for a security action.
Forbidden admin sub-pages render their full chrome (title, search box, empty table) with only a toast, giving no persistent indication that access was denied.

issues: Home hero claims 'Every upload - and every new version - is scanned'; feature tiles claim 'Multi-stage pre-screen / AV + static analysis' - the scanning pipeline was intentionally SKIPPED in this build, so this is a false security claim to end users
Feature tile 'OAuth-only accounts / No password to breach' contradicts the actual JWT email/password auth (and the Google/Discord buttons are disabled placeholders)
Login hero repeats 'Every upload is scanned.'
UploadVersionModal says 'Server-side type verification runs on upload' but only mimetypes.guess_type(filename) runs
Layout, spacing, contrast and the retro-industrial theme render correctly at 1920x1080; no horizontal overflow at 390px on /browse

action_items: Add login rate limiting / account lockout after 5 failed attempts (currently unlimited 401s).
Enforce revoke-sessions: store session_revoked_at and reject tokens issued before it in get_current_user (or add an iat check) - today the action is a no-op behind a success toast.
Gate GET /api/mods/{slug} on status=='approved' unless the caller is the owner or staff; unapproved submissions are currently public.
Fix moderate_version: approving a version must not resurrect a rejected/quarantined parent mod.
Validate age_confirm on POST /api/auth/register and add min_length to CommentInput.body.
Preserve or clearly separate seeded rating_count from real reviews so posting one review doesn't drop a mod from 4.6 (2100) to 4.0 (1).
Set explicit CORS origins instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True.
Add an upload size cap and real content-based type sniffing (magic bytes) for version files, or soften the UI copy.
Hide/disable admin sidebar items the current staff role cannot access and render an inline permission-denied panel instead of a blank page + toast.
Make Browse search debounce live (or add a visible Search button) - typing currently appears to do nothing.
Rewrite Home/Login marketing copy: remove 'scanned / AV + static analysis' and 'OAuth-only accounts / No password to breach' claims that this build does not implement.
Add a mobile hamburger menu so Browse/Minecraft are reachable under 768px.
Give a version file to the seeded quantum-tools-beta version so approving it from the queue yields a working download.
critical_code_review_comments: Never pass an async/Promise-returning function directly to useEffect - React treats the return value as the cleanup fn. This pattern also exists (harmlessly today) in CreatorDashboard.jsx:22 `useEffect(load, [])`; convert it too before `load` becomes async.

get_current_user reads a cookie that login never sets (server.py:85) - either implement the httpOnly cookie flow or delete the dead branch; `get_optional_user` (server.py:102) is also defined but never used.

Admin authorization is enforced only server-side per-endpoint while the client renders every nav item; keep the server checks but derive the visible nav from a shared role->permission map so UI and API cannot drift.
server.py is a single 876-line module mixing auth, public, creator, admin and seeding - split into routers (auth/public/creator/admin) plus a seed module before it grows further.
app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to the FastAPI lifespan context manager.
Every list endpoint uses a hard-coded to_list(N) with no skip/limit params - add pagination now while the response shapes are still cheap to change.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all critical flows pass after the admin-queue crash fix; remaining issues are UX/content)

seed_data_creation: Test accounts were registered on the @kivoqa.io domain and test mods/versions/reviews/comments were created, then ALL of it was deleted by /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_data.py. Seeded state was restored and verified: 9 mods, 6 users, quantum-tools-beta back to in_review with 1 pending version, 2 open reports (malware=critical, harassment). NOTE: pytest and Playwright runs re-create @kivoqa.io data; re-run `python /app/backend/tests/cleanup_qa_data.py` from /app/backend afterwards. Also note the email-validator rejects special-use TLDs (.test/.example) - use @kivoqa.io for synthetic accounts.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present and fully accurate - admin@kivo.dev/KivoAdmin!2026 (super_admin), creator@kivo.dev/Creator!2026 (verified), and all four Staff!2026 staff accounts logged in successfully with the documented roles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite lives in /app/backend/tests (conftest.py + test_public/test_auth/test_creator/test_admin/test_engagement). Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; do not edit it). Six tests are intentional red flags for the gaps listed above - they should flip green once fixed: test_brute_force_lockout, test_login_sets_httponly_cookie, test_revoke_sessions_invalidates_token, test_unapproved_mod_detail_exposure, test_register_age_confirm_enforced, test_empty_comment_rejected. Everything else already passes, including full CRUD/moderation/trust flows. Playwright verified end-to-end: home/browse(filters+Enter-search)/mod detail(4 tabs + real file download that increments the counter), register(age-confirm gating)/login, creator dashboard(KPIs+14-day recharts+11 project rows)/4-step wizard auto-publish/multipart version upload, admin overview/queue(approve+diff modal+reason modal)/reports(resolve+dismiss+4 filters)/users(trust select+role select+verify/shadow/ban/revoke+search)/audit(49 entries, newest-first, moderation actions appear)/anomalies(3 panels). Non-staff and creator accounts are correctly redirected off /admin. Remember the tool-side gotcha: don't put escaped quotes or backslashes inside Playwright f-strings.
rca_of_the_issue: Admin queue/reports crash: ReviewQueue.jsx:13 and Reports.jsx:21 used `useEffect(load, deps)` where `load = () => api.get(...).then(...)` returns a Promise. React 18/19 invokes the effect's return value as the destroy/cleanup function, so on unmount it threw 'TypeError: destroy is not a function' (commitHookEffectListUnmount -> destroy is not a function). In dev the CRA error overlay then covered the whole page, making the Review Queue and Reports & Abuse screens appear completely broken. Repro: log in as admin@kivo.dev, visit /admin/queue, navigate away. Fix applied: wrap in `useEffect(() => { load(); }, deps)` so the effect returns undefined. Verified afterwards with zero pageerrors across all 13 routes.
